dct_description_sm: Coordinating the tasks of collaborating team members somtimes becomes a huge task in itself. Known as articulation work, this work can become more burdensome than the main task or work that it is supposed to support. Using stigmergy, embedding the coordination signals and cues into the main work piece itself, can help to mitigate this risk. This project explores how TTalk3 can be used to explore stigmergy in OLab cases.
